title: Peak-hour vertiport congestion
description: Two hundred drones try to leave within one minute, more than the pads and corridor junctions can take. The DTC runs a ground-delay program: departures in the north-west and north-centre sectors are stopped and released in turn, and traffic into the busy centre is metered with a speed limit.
timeline: Ground stop S3 (until 90 s) and S4 (until 120 s)
Speed limit 8 m/s in S1 for 60 s
